name: Andrew Wong
content: We had 3 bedrooms and our living room cleaned by Brimley's. Our technician was James and he did an excellent job. He was very professional, informative and did a thorough job. He graciously wore a mask as we have an elder individual living at our place. We asked for his input on our couch and he gave us a very thorough answer that allowed us to make an informed decision to hold off on trying to clean the microfiber sofa, which we were told would not have gotten much benefit from trying to clean. Overall, it was affordable had we decided to not add the additional Scotch Guard treatment. With it, it is a little bit more expensive than other companies, but I'd rather spend the extra money knowing I'm getting good service. I like the Chem-Dry method they used. The carpet was mostly dry in 2 hours and definitely dry by about 4-5 hours. The carpets all feel much more fresh and the rooms smell much better with less dust and congestion causing allergens. I would definitely recommend using them and will use them again.

name: Chris OKeefe
content: James was great!  Very prompt, professional and did a  great job on my bedroom carpets and area rug.  Scheduling was a breeze and they got me scheduled within a couple days.  My carpets were dry within a few hours and they look and smell fresh and clean.   I will definitely use them again and would also highly recommend them.

name: AW
content: I have used Brimley's White Glove ChemDry regularly since 2006 to keep my carpets, area rugs and furniture clean and fresh.  It's a job that is neither quick or easy; over 7000 square feet, custom carpets and furniture, some of it white, complicated by 4 cats, a dog and my son.  Brimley's is always up to the task.  After the first time, I've never even thought about calling anyone else.  The great experience starts when I call; so pleasant and accomodating every time.  And, the technicians are the best.  I have not had the same techs for seven years, but the type of person they hire is always the same; punctual, polite, professional, clean-cut and respectful not only of me, but my property.  This last time was no exception.  Peter and Christian were great.  They took as much time with the last room as they did the first.  Obviously, their focus was on getting the job done right, not getting it done fast so they could leave.  I really appreciate not only their work, but that I feel comfortable having them in the house.  Brimley's is worth every penny; don't hesitate to use them.

name: Chris OKeefe
content: James was great! Very prompt, professional and did a great job on my bedroom carpets and area rug. Scheduling was a breeze and they got me scheduled within a couple days. My carpets were dry within a few hours and they look and smell fresh and clean. I will definitely use them again and would also highly recommend them.

name: Aedan Boscia
content:
I’ve used Brimleys twice for move out/cleaning. Both times, the value for the work done has been great, overall I’m very happy with the fact that I get the quoted price without surprises on site for extra charges.
However, this last time I had a VERY severe stain/damage issue with carpet. Because the carpet was warrantied against stains, I wanted to try to get anything that would come out, out, so that we could evaluate for the warranty (we had to attempt to clean it first!)
To be honest, I had very low expectations because the damage was so bad.
My tech Nick was great, he was on time, positive, and fairly optimistic about getting at least some of the damage out. He was also very nice, worked hard and was helpful with information about the cleaning.
The process doesn’t take too long, the carpets dry fairly quickly, and above all-a good deal of the staining and dirt came out.
Now, this situation is above and beyond what most normal staining should look like. If this had been “normal” wear and tear/staining, I’m sure these carpets would look brand new. However-Brimleys far exceeded my expectations on getting it to any level of clean, and actually got it to what might be considered a normal amount of clean!
I will absolutely continue to use and recommend Brimleys for our carpet cleaning needs!

name: Konnie Sheen
content: Very professional and knowledgeable technician (Rob). He was efficient and did an amazing job on the carpets and an ottoman.  He was able to get out the chocolate milk stains in the dining room and everything looks so much brighter! I had forgotten how good my carpets could look. Tech was personable and communicated well.  I would highly recommend Brimley's and will definitely use them again!

name: Sheetal Chhaya
content:
James and Nick were excellent from the moment they stepped foot into the house.  They started by asking if I'd prefer that they wear masks which I really appreciated.  I just thought that was very respectful.

Prior to them coming I received updates about their timing because there was a large window of time for when they were supposed to be at the home. That helped me schedule my day as well.

When they came to the home I showed them the areas that we needed cleaning and initially I had also wanted them to clean our very light colored upholstered kitchen chairs. When they looked at them they very honestly told me that they were quite light and that the moisture they use with their product and their cleaning technique may actually cause a discoloration and they likely would not look as I would expect. I actually appreciated her honesty very much and we were able to take that off of the work order.

They were prompt and very respectful of our space. They put up a lot of plastic wall guards so that their vacuum and tubing did not scuff the walls as they worked. The end result was beautifull!  They even got out pet urine from the corners one of our rooms!
Overall I would recommend them to others and most definitely use them again. We had use them about five years ago and they were the only company that I thought to go back to.

name: randy gilbert
content: When I called to get quotes on carpet cleaning Devon was very helpful and answered all of my questions. My tech, Eric, and his trainee, George, called when they were on the way and arrived earlier than expected, which I was very pleased about. I walked Eric through the house talking about any issues I might have. When the job was complete we walked the house again and I signed off on a job well done. Eric and his trainee were very polite and efficient. I recommend Brimley to take care of your carpet needs.

name: All Things Wavy
content:
I have used Brimley's as my primary carpet cleaner for about 8 years now. Every single employee, from the dispatch to the cleaning technicians, are knowledgeable, polite, and time efficient. And, as a pet owner, the cleaning is, in my experience, top quality.

I chose a Chem-Dry company because of their specific cleaning method and the very quick dry time. I tried one of their competitors once. Only once. And I was back at Brimley's for the next round of cleaning. Would highly recommend this particular Chem-Dry company for reliable, high quality service.

name: Marcy Moore
content:
Our carpets were past needing a good cleaning. I found Brimley’s through a Google
Search and because they were near my home and had great reviews, I completed the online quote and scheduled my service. We had a short setback with other work being completed in our home and easily was able to push their service back a few days with no problems. We had stairs and a couple of rooms done. The house smells great and the floors are like new again!

Will be having them back to do 2 area rugs and 2 more rooms!

100% recommend!
